cap_drift.manage_options_gate_note: Bare current_user_can('manage_options') checks across plugin admin/REST/AJAX paths. Plugin gates ALL 9 admin pages, ALL 22 REST routes, and ALL admin AJAX handlers behind manage_options — typical WP pattern but a permission monoculture: only full administrators can operate the plugin. No granular plugin caps exist; staff/editor workflows are not supported. Future enhancement opportunity: introduce wbam_manage_ads / wbam_view_analytics caps and gate non-destructive views (analytics dashboard) at a lower threshold.
cap_drift.scanner_note: Scanned every PHP file in build/free/wb-ads-rotator-with-split-test (72 files). Detected zero add_role / add_cap declarations. CPT 'wbam-ad' uses capability_type=post with default map_meta_cap (false) — no primitive caps auto-generated; all CPT screens fall back to manage_options (post-type default for non-public CPTs without explicit capability map). FREE plugin registers 0 custom capabilities.

notes: Settings clean-up (card 10343726590, 2026-09-26): removed 2 dead fields with no reader anywhere (_wbam_ad_data[after_posts]/[posts_repeat] and the whole Archive Settings metabox panel, which only showed for a placement id 'archive' that does not exist), and converted 2 rarely-changed fields to filters: container_class (wbam_ad_container_class) and the email-capture ad's cookie_days (wbam_email_capture_cookie_days). Every filter's default is the site's/ad's already-stored value, so upgraded sites and ads behave the same.
